hassio_confirm.title: Local OCR app
hassio_confirm.description: Set up Home Assistant to use the Local OCR app that is running on this system.

zeroconf_confirm.title: Local OCR found
zeroconf_confirm.description: Found a Local OCR server at {url}.

data_description.token: The LOCAL_OCR_TOKEN value the server was started with.

user.title: Connect to Local OCR
user.description: Enter the address of your Local OCR server.

data_description.url: Where the Local OCR server listens, for example http://192.168.1.20:8738. The Local OCR app sets this up for you; you only need this form for a standalone container.
data_description.token: The LOCAL_OCR_TOKEN value the server was started with. Leave empty if it runs without one.

test.title: Test the connection

test_failed.title: Test the connection
test_failed.description: The connection test didn't pass. Fix the problem shown below, then select Submit to try again.

reauth_confirm.title: Access token needed
reauth_confirm.description: The Local OCR server rejected the access token. Enter the current one.

data_description.token: The LOCAL_OCR_TOKEN value the server uses now.

reauth_managed.title: Restart the Local OCR app
reauth_managed.description: Local OCR rejected the saved access token. Restart the Local OCR app (Settings > Apps > Local OCR > Restart): when it starts it gives Home Assistant its current token. Then select Submit.

data_description.url: The new address of the Local OCR server, for example http://192.168.1.20:8738.

error.cannot_connect: Can't reach the Local OCR app. Make sure it is installed and started.
error.timeout: Local OCR didn't answer in time. Try again in a moment.
error.not_local_ocr: That address doesn't look like a Local OCR server.
error.app_outdated: The Local OCR app is too old for this integration. Update the app.
error.model_failed: The app is running but its OCR model failed to load. Restart the app.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant log.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one Local OCR server can be configured.

data_description.preset: Used when an action doesn't pick a preset.
data_description.min_confidence: Text recognised with less confidence than this is dropped (0 to 1). Used when an action doesn't set it.
data_description.timeout: How long to wait for one read. Reads with all_frames get at least 180 s.

not_loaded.message: Local OCR is not set up or not loaded.

exactly_one_source.message: Provide exactly one of image_entity, camera_entity, file_path or media_content_id.

path_not_allowed.message: Home Assistant isn't allowed to read {path}. Add its folder to allowlist_external_dirs.

file_unreadable.message: Home Assistant couldn't read the file {path}.

too_large.message: The image is too large (max 10 MB, 40 megapixels).

unsupported_image.message: The file isn't an image Local OCR can read.

app_unavailable.message: The Local OCR app isn't running.

auth_failed.message: Local OCR rejected the access token. Open Settings > Devices & services to re-authenticate.

timeout.message: Local OCR didn't answer within {timeout} s.

invalid_region.message: The region must have non-negative x and y, a positive width and height, and use either all fractions (0–1) or all pixels.

unexpected_error.message: Unexpected Local OCR error ({error}). Check the Home Assistant log.

read_image.name: Read image
read_image.description: Reads the text in an image with the Local OCR app and returns the result.

config_entry_id.name: Local OCR server
config_entry_id.description: Which Local OCR server to use. Optional when only one is set up.

image_entity.name: Image entity
image_entity.description: Read the current picture of this image entity.

camera_entity.name: Camera entity
camera_entity.description: Read a snapshot from this camera.

file_path.name: File path
file_path.description: Read this file. Its folder must be in allowlist_external_dirs.

media_content_id.name: Media
media_content_id.description: Read this item from a media source.

preset.name: Preset
preset.description: What kind of text to expect. Defaults to the preset in the integration options.

region.name: Region
region.description: Only read this part of the image, as x, y, w and h. Values of 1 or less are fractions of the image width and height; larger values are pixels.

min_confidence.name: Minimum confidence
min_confidence.description: Drop text recognised with less confidence than this (0 to 1). Defaults to the integration option.

all_frames.name: All frames
all_frames.description: For animated images, read every frame instead of just the first.

app_not_running.title: The Local OCR app is stopped

confirm.title: Start the Local OCR app
confirm.description: The Local OCR app is stopped. Select Submit to start it.

abort.cannot_start: The app couldn't be started. Start it from the Local OCR app page.

app_not_running_unmanaged.title: Local OCR isn't reachable
app_not_running_unmanaged.description: Start the local-ocr container (docker start local-ocr).

app_outdated.title: The Local OCR app is too old
app_outdated.description: The Local OCR app is older than this integration needs. Update the app.

model_failed.title: The Local OCR model failed to load
model_failed.description: The app is running but its OCR model failed to load: {detail}. Restart the app.

low_memory.title: The Local OCR app is low on memory
low_memory.description: The Local OCR app ran out of memory while reading images. Close other apps, or lower max_side in the Local OCR app's options.
